svg.title: One-motor integrated bench wiring with display, clock, controls and load cell
svg.desc: One assembled view of two full-size breadboards. Trace wire IDs and look up both terminals in the connector list below.
svg.text: One motor with the screen, controls, clock and scale
Add the new wires on A. The motor, driver, encoder and board-to-board link are the existing assembly shown in your reference.
Disconnect both USB cables and 12 V while wiring. For the first check, power both Feathers by computer USB only. Disconnect the LM2596 +5 V feeds.
Meter polarity. Keep power off while wiring.
Use one computer USB cable per Feather.
D1 receives fused 12 V DC at Vmotor.
Each ground goes to the common block.

g.title: B TX/GPIO8 to A A3/GPIO39 RX
A GND to its ground rail
B GND to its ground rail
1 kΩ resistor from STBY to GND
B 27/GPIO27 to D1 PWMA at h15
O1 D1 AOUT1 top pad (d17) → Motor red
O2 D1 AOUT2 top pad (d18) → Motor black
P1 12 V DC positive → Fuse input
P2 Fuse output → D1 Vmotor + terminal
P3 12 V DC negative → Common GND block
P4 Common GND block → D1 GND − terminal
C1+ D1 Vmotor + terminal → Capacitor + lead
C1− D1 GND − terminal → Capacitor striped − lead
UA Computer USB port A → A micro-USB connector
UB Computer USB port B → B USB-C connector

svg.text: Place A and B as drawn, with their USB ports facing row 63.
Plug A peripherals into the numbered rows using header jumpers.
Each a–e strip shares a connection. Each f–j strip is separate.
A dot marks a wire end. Crossing lines alone do not connect.
TFT Vin takes USB 5 V from A:a56 through row 1.
RTC, knob and both HX711 supply pins use the 3.3 V rail.
Keep TFT 3Vo open. Use the display’s SPI configuration.
The two boards share ground and use separate 3.3 V rails.
Use one normally open contact and COM on each button.
The button inputs use the Feather’s internal pull-ups.
RH is a 10 kΩ resistor from HX711 DAT to 3.3 V.
Leave the unconnected HX711 YLW pad empty.
Fix the wired end to the base and mount the tray on the free end.
Leave space for the center of the bar to flex under load.
Keep the combined load of tray and test mass within 100 g.
can stay off for this test.
A:j54 means board A, column j, row 54. A:+01 means the first hole on board A’s left positive rail. Each row below describes one physical wire, cable or resistor.
HUZZAH32 A + FEATHER ESP32 V2 B • TB6612 #2448
